meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先制定决策完备的开发计划，再动手写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 装上后，当你明确要求先规划再写代码（如说了技能名或“plan this”），Claude 会亮出“ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!”并以规划顾问身份工作：只做只读探索，把请求拆成执行者无需再追问的工作计划；此后哪怕你说“做X”“修X”，它也只会先规划，不碰产品代码。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求该流程时触发，例如说“ulw-plan”“plan this”“make a plan”等，或要求先出工作计划再写代码。普通编码请求不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给登录接口加限流，先出计划。
say.note: 它会先探索代码库，再就关键分叉问你。

say.text: plan this：重构认证模块，先别写代码。
say.note: 意图明确时只问必要问题，然后等你点头。

say.text: make a plan：按这个需求写一份可执行的工作计划。
say.note: 计划写完后需你批准，执行另起会话。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planning consultant (Prometheus): explores read-only, turns one request into a single decision-complete work plan under `.omo/`, never edits code, and writes the plan only after your explicit approval.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit user request (e.g. "ulw-plan", "plan this", "make a plan") or when you ask for a plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to make a rate-limit plan for the login endpoint.
say_en.note: Explores the codebase first, then asks about remaining forks.

say_en.text: plan this: refactor the auth module, don't write code yet.
say_en.note: Routes intent CLEAR/UNCLEAR, then decides whether to interview you.

say_en.text: make a plan: write an executable work plan for this request.
say_en.note: Approval required before writing; execution starts separately.
